text:
node-monitor-bot: ALERT: gpu-node-17 reporting rapid correctable ECC spikes + Xid 13 resets. 3 resets in 90s, nv-host log shows nv-driver-reset. Affected service: inference-runtime-prod. Auto-escalate to @sre-oncall :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: on it. assessing impact now. @lia can you grab telemetry?

lia (runtime): pulling logs, attaching top-level summary. looks like kvcache memory grew then OOM in containerd + gpu driver reset. kernel: "NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, PID 4123" repeated.

ram (infra): nodes metrics show GPU memory pressure on node-17 and node-18 increasing at same time. both same rack. could be a damaging batch.

maria (eng): any customer-visible errors? dash shows 1% error rate spike for generation endpoints, increased latency 200-600ms for a subset of shards.

kevin (support): getting one customer report (acct 3389) timeouts. Triage: high priority, they're on dedicated capacity with failover. opening bridge if impact grows.

lia (runtime): quick tail of dmesg from node-17:
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13,13,13
[ 12346.123456] kernel: nvidia: GPU at 0000:65:00: resetting
[ 12346.223456] containerd: container runtime oom killed inference-worker-abc
```
Looks like repeated driver resets -> container crash -> kvcache leak reaccumulate.

sre-oncall: options: 1) cordon+drain node-17, soft-evict pods to other nodes (risk moving load); 2) quick nv-host reset and restart nvidia driver on node; 3) scale up fallback machines (cpu/gpu) while evacuating. What does runbook recommend?

lia (runtime): runbook: prefer cordon+evacuate if more than 1 reset in 5m. If single transient, restart driver. This is already 3 in 90s -> recommend cordon+drain.

ram (infra): initiating cordon node-17 now: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17`

ops-bot: node gpu-node-17 marked Unschedulable by ram (infra) at 4315012360

maria (eng): initiating drain with grace 120s, evict tolerant pods first. also preparing a canary route to fallback model-quantized-2 to limit memory.

kevin (support): notifying impacted customer (acct 3389) on bridge: "we're investigating GPU resets, will update in 10m".

lia (runtime): drain output snippet: 
```
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
evicted: inference-worker-abc, inference-worker-def
error: some pods failed: inference-sidecar-xyz (will retry)
```
One pod failed to evict cleanly (sidecar stuck). killing containerd task and retrying.

sre-oncall: killing stuck container and forcing eviction.

lia (runtime): forced eviction succeeded. pods rescheduled to node-21 and node-23. monitoring kvcache growth on targets.

ram (infra): scheduling reboot for gpu-node-17 after drain. will attempt safe reboot (no immediate hardware power cycle).

maria (eng): rolling routing rule: shift 10% of traffic away from inference-runtime-prod shards on node pool-A to pool-B and enable fallback-quantized route. command: `rbctl route add --from shard-A --to pool-B --weight 10%`

product-bridge-bot: Customer impact status change: limited errors (<2% of requests) affecting some dedicated customers. bridge opened for acct 3389.

lia (runtime): after eviction, telemetry shows Xid noise quiet on other nodes. node-17 still shows ECC correctable spike in kernel logs. will hold reboot and let infra do full reboot.

ram (infra): rebooting node-17 now: `sudo systemctl reboot` -> monitoring.

ops-bot: reboot initiated on gpu-node-17 by ram (infra) at 4315012398

lia (runtime): post-reboot: driver reloaded but nv-host reports ECC counters elevated; running memtest mode on GPU diagnostic (non-blocking) and leaving node out of pool until clean.

maria (eng): perf note: rescheduled pods to node-21/23 saw slight latency bump for ~3m while kv-warmup occurs. cost estimate: negligible. keep fallback ramped at 10% for 15m.

kevin (support): updated customer on bridge: "we evacuated affected host, rescheduling done, monitoring. next update in 15m or sooner if changes."

lia (runtime): follow-up logs show one instance of `NVRM: ECC error: corrected single-bit` on gpu-17, counts decreasing. NVML diagnostic OK for now.

sre-oncall: closing paging alert if stability holds for 30m. action items: 1) infra to log kernel nv-host dumps from node-17 and open hardware ticket if ECC persists. 2) runtime to add guard in kvcache for sudden growth pattern. 3) product to notify customers in 1h with summary.

ram (infra): action item created: HW-2026 - collect nv-host logs, run extended GPU memtest, vendor engagement if >10 corrected ECC events in 24h.

maria (eng): runtime action item: add a temporary circuit-breaker that rejects new long-context inference jobs to reduce kvcache pressure. will produce PR today.

kevin (support): I'll coordinate customer comms and log bridge notes.

product-bridge-bot: Incident severity set to SEV3. Bridge will remain open until next update.

lia (runtime): monitoring window started. will post metrics snapshot at +10m and +30m.

sre-oncall: thanks team. pre-briefing for handoff to next oncall at +45m. leaving thread open. :thumbsup:"
